quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ

إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

parent_channels.name: Calibrated Course and Bounded Sight (P1: 53:1-18)

subchannels.name: Celestial markers establish a traversable course
subchannels.scene_or_process: A star rises or appears against a distant horizon, where it functions as a conspicuous landmark by which a route can be examined and known.
subchannels.active_motifs: star as celestial body `quranic:root_001475:B001/m01`; star appearing `quranic:root_001475:B002/m01`; examining stars to plan `quranic:root_001475:B005/m01`; prominent route marker `quranic:root_001475:B006/m01`; distant horizon `quranic:root_000040:B001/m01`; knowledge that uncovers a thing `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; landmark or road marker `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The opening star is activated as an orienting instrument: its visibility at the horizon makes a course legible and prepares for the later claim that a major sign was actually seen.

subchannels.name: Nearness is measured while sight holds its line
subchannels.scene_or_process: An approach is gauged by a bow-shaped span, brought into alignment, and stopped at an endpoint while the eye remains centered.
subchannels.active_motifs: arc or bend `quranic:root_001267:B004/m01`; nearness `quranic:root_001267:B006/m01`; measuring by an exemplar `quranic:root_001269:B001/m01`; bow or cubit measure `quranic:root_001269:B002/m01`; bow as instrument `quranic:root_001269:B003/m01`; ordinary nearness `quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`; straightening and completion `quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`; terminal point `quranic:root_001560:B002/m01`; ocular sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; eye drift `quranic:root_000658:B002/m01`; overstepping a limit `quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The bow measure is not merely a distance comparison. It materializes a controlled approach whose validity depends equally on geometric limit and disciplined vision.

subchannels.name: Losing the course ends in vacancy or a pit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler loses a marker or trace, deviates from the route, and drops into an empty depression where forward movement fails.
subchannels.active_motifs: path error `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; lost object or trace `quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`; misguidance `quranic:root_001116:B001/m01`; hunter's pit `quranic:root_001116:B004/m01`; void or open air `quranic:root_001609:B001/m01`; falling into an abyss `quranic:root_001609:B002/m01`; barren terrain `quranic:root_001274:B003/m01`; hole or depression `quranic:root_001267:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The denial of deviation is pressured by its latent physical contrary: failed orientation is a fall from a marked course into an empty, unproductive trap.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reliable arrival depends on markers, measured approach, and perception that neither drifts nor exceeds its bound.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The celestial oath and visual encounter become a navigation-and-calibration scene rather than a collection of isolated signs.

parent_channels.name: Descent into a Receiving Place (P1: 53:1-18)

subchannels.name: Descent crosses upper space toward a lower station
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something moves from an elevated horizon, comes down in stages, and approaches a designated station.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward fall `quranic:root_001609:B003/m01`; rapid downward movement `quranic:root_001609:B008/m01`; elevation `quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`; upper direction `quranic:root_001042:B005/m01`; descent and settling `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`; a single descent `quranic:root_001492:B010/m01`; distant horizon `quranic:root_000040:B001/m01`; nearness `quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The movement from horizon to nearness can be read as a staged descent whose completion requires a lower station rather than an unbounded fall.

subchannels.name: A bucket draws the descending object to a terminal pool
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bucket is lowered, reaches its target through an intermediary, and draws toward a bounded body of water.
subchannels.active_motifs: bucket `quranic:root_000485:B001/m01`; well `quranic:root_000485:B001/m02`; lowering from a height `quranic:root_000485:B010/m01`; reaching a goal through an intermediary `quranic:root_000485:B004/m01`; hole or depression `quranic:root_001267:B001/m01`; terminal pool `quranic:root_001560:B004/m01`; descent and settling `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical network turns proximity into a drawing operation: descent is controlled by an intermediary and completed at a contained endpoint.

subchannels.name: The destination is lodging, refuge, and hidden enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Arrival culminates in a station that lodges a guest, gathers what approaches, and protects it within a concealed enclosure.
subchannels.active_motifs: lodging or station `quranic:root_001492:B003/m01`; guest provision `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; gathering as refuge `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; compassion in sheltering `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; garden hidden by trees `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; hiding place `quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`; nearness or presence `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; protective nurture `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The terminal scene is not only spatial. It combines station, hospitality, refuge, and concealment, making the boundary a protected place of reception.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Downward movement becomes meaningful when it is received, drawn, and settled at a bounded destination.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The descent vocabulary coheres with wells, buckets, lodging, and refuge, giving the encounter a receiving-place structure.

parent_channels.name: Controlled Disclosure Across Veils (P1: 53:1-18)

subchannels.name: A concealed signal is encoded and rapidly transmitted
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge passes by hidden conveyance, gesture, inscription, or swift signal before taking a speakable form.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden conveyance of knowledge `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; communicative gesture `quranic:root_001633:B002/m01`; writing or engraving `quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`; divine inspiration `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; speed of transmission `quranic:root_001633:B006/m01`; speaking sign `quranic:root_001519:B002/m01`; instruction `quranic:root_001040:B001/m02`; submission in service `quranic:root_000973:B003/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: The utterance is the endpoint of a prior hidden operation: a signal is conveyed, encoded, taught, and received under a relation of service.

subchannels.name: Outer sight and the inner heart register the disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ocular seeing supplies an appearance while the heart supplies an inward act of recognition or judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: ocular seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; insight through seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m02`; heart's judgment or thought `quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`; showing or making visible `quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`; heart as an inner flame `quranic:root_001122:B002/m01`; accusation of falsehood `quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`; ocular sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; heart-insight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The heart does not replace the eye, nor the eye the heart. Their paired registration explains why the passage can distinguish seeing, inward confirmation, and denial.

subchannels.name: Covering pressures vision without dislodging it
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sweeping cover, haze, or hanging screen passes over the field of sight, yet the observer neither drifts nor exceeds the visual boundary.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical covering `quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`; sweeping universal cover `quranic:root_001088:B002/m01`; visual haze `quranic:root_000688:B003/m01`; hanging cloth `quranic:root_000688:B004/m01`; hanging hair `quranic:root_000688:B004/m02`; eye drift `quranic:root_000658:B002/m01`; shield before the eye `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; overstepping a limit `quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The covering is useful pressure on the primary reading: the vision is warranted not by an unobstructed field but by remaining stable under a moving veil.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A hidden communication becomes warranted through ordered transmission, inward registration, and sight that withstands obstruction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Revelation, witnessing, and visual restraint form one disclosure mechanism with distinct transmission and verification stages.

parent_channels.name: Load-Bearing Assembly (P1: 53:1-18)

subchannels.name: Strands are tightened into aligned tensile strength
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate strands are tightened into a cord, brought to firmness, and aligned so that the assembly can bear force.
subchannels.active_motifs: tightening a knot `quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`; force and solidity `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; strength as strands of cord `quranic:root_001274:B001/m01`; tightly twisted cord `quranic:root_001414:B005/m01`; firm strength `quranic:root_001414:B006/m01`; straightening and completion `quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`; settled upright alignment `quranic:root_000766:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 53:5 (ش د د, ق و ي); 53:6 (م ر ر, س و ي).
subchannels.synthesis: Strength emerges as a relation among tension, twist, and alignment, closely materializing the passage's paired predicates of force and settled form.

subchannels.name: Hide, seam, cord, and pad distribute the load
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hair-on hide is tanned or peeled, sewn into panels, tied by cord, and padded for stable bearing.
subchannels.active_motifs: hair-on hide `quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`; hide in tanning `quranic:root_000040:B005/m01`; skin peeling `quranic:root_001267:B002/m01`; sewn hide panels `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; tightly twisted cord `quranic:root_001414:B005/m01`; saddle cloth or pad `quranic:root_000766:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The network supplies a concrete load-bearing object whose strength depends on preparation and fit, not merely on harder material.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Strength is produced by tightening, twisting, aligning, and distributing load across prepared materials.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 53:5-6, with local lexical anchors through 53:17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The teacher's strength is reframed as engineered tensile integrity rather than undifferentiated force.

parent_channels.name: Names, Shares, and Unwarranted Claims (P2: 53:19-32)

subchannels.name: Inherited labels fabricate stable categories
subchannels.scene_or_process: Names received from ancestors are repeated until they appear to designate real, gendered kinds despite lacking authorization.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; reputation sustained by a name `quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`; father or ancestor `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; spoken name `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`; male category `quranic:root_000516:B001/m01`; female category `quranic:root_000058:B001/m01`; fabricated utterance `quranic:root_001450:B013/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The labels gain social durability from ancestry and repetition, but the channel exposes that durability as manufactured speech rather than ontological proof.

subchannels.name: Classification fixes a deficient share
subchannels.scene_or_process: A whole is divided into ranked portions; one party reserves the preferred allotment and assigns the diminished part elsewhere.
subchannels.active_motifs: division into shares `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; third share `quranic:root_000203:B002/m01`; completing a third `quranic:root_000203:B003/m01`; unjust or deficient allocation `quranic:root_000922:B001/m01`; entitlement `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; owned right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; legal deed `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; wished-for claim `quranic:root_001450:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The unequal division is not incidental to the naming system. The labels act like entries in a deed that assign rights before any proof has been produced.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Labels become false claims when inherited naming is used to authorize an unequal distribution without evidence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Naming and apportionment are one operation: a category label silently predetermines who receives the deficient share.

parent_channels.name: Competing Guidance Systems (P2: 53:19-32)

subchannels.name: Desire follows an uncertain trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inner inclination treats a weak sign as a track, follows it, and mistakes an uncertain outcome for a warranted course.
subchannels.active_motifs: tracking a predecessor `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`; sensory shadow `quranic:root_000175:B008/m01`; weak guess `quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`; uncertain outcome `quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`; desire `quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`; inner intent `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; self or essence `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; road or course `quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`.

subchannels.name: A leader keeps a following body on the road
subchannels.scene_or_process: A front guide or animal leader moves first while followers, including a calf behind a cow, maintain the same path.
subchannels.active_motifs: leader at the front `quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`; gentle road-guidance `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; animal leader `quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`; calf following a cow `quranic:root_000175:B007/m01`; consequence following an act `quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`; road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; travelers on a road `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`.

subchannels.name: Turning away selects a lower endpoint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person turns the side away from reminder, chooses a near benefit, and stops at the limit of that knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning the side `quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`; turning away `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; willing or intending `quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`; reaching a limit `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; lower or nearer world `quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`; life as immediate benefit `quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`; spoken reminder `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Refusal is rendered as route selection: turning from reminder and preferring the near benefit sets both the direction and the epistemic stopping point.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conduct follows whichever guide is treated as authoritative: evidence and a marked road, or desire and an uncertain trace.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Guidance is modeled as route-following, animal leadership, shadowing, and choice of a terminal destination.

parent_channels.name: Permission-Gated Advocacy (P2: 53:19-32)

subchannels.name: An advocate enters only through an authorized gate
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gatekeeper grants entry, an advocate joins another's case, and the sovereign decides whether that joinder is acceptable.
subchannels.active_motifs: permission and gatekeeping `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; advocate joining another `quranic:root_000802:B002/m01`; adding or pairing `quranic:root_000802:B001/m01`; acceptance `quranic:root_000569:B001/m01`; winning approval `quranic:root_000569:B004/m01`; sovereign authority `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; entity or matter under decision `quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`; sufficing for another `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 53:26 (ء ذ ن, ش ف ع, ر ض و, م ل ك, ش ي ء, غ ن ي); 53:27 (م ل ك); 53:28 (ش ي ء, غ ن ي).
subchannels.synthesis: The advocate has no independent efficacy. Every transition in the process remains gated by permission and acceptance from the authority that owns the case.

subchannels.name: Joining a case does not erase individual liability
subchannels.scene_or_process: One party may stand in for or join another, but the account still distinguishes ownership, debt, deed, and due recompense.
subchannels.active_motifs: standing in for another `quranic:root_000244:B002/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; joining as advocate `quranic:root_000802:B002/m01`; owned right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; protected obligation `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`; legal deed `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; wage for work `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Representation can alter who speaks or stands in the proceeding, but it cannot dissolve the ledger categories by which liability is assigned.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Representation is effective only when entry, joining, and acceptance are authorized by the controlling authority.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Intercession is decomposed into gatekeeping, joinder, approval, and substitution rather than treated as a single magical act.

parent_channels.name: Action Enters Settlement (P2: 53:19-32)

subchannels.name: Work is classified by its produced effect
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intentional work produces either harmful or beneficent effects and is entered under the corresponding moral class.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; dealings or practice `quranic:root_001046:B005/m01`; bad or ugly act `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; harm produced `quranic:root_000755:B002/m01`; good quality `quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`; beneficent act `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 53:31 (ع م ل, س و ء, ح س ن).
subchannels.synthesis: Good and bad are not free-floating labels; they describe what intentional conduct becomes and what effects it places into the account.

subchannels.name: The ledger converts deeds into due settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A deed establishes a claim, wage, debt, or protected obligation that is discharged by equivalent recompense.
subchannels.active_motifs: legal deed `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; wage `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`; entitlement `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; protected obligation `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`; recompense `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; debt settlement `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; financial due `quranic:root_000244:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense is activated as account settlement: the quality of work generates a due that must be discharged rather than arbitrarily assigned.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conduct becomes an assessable entry that is classified and repaid according to its moral quality.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The moral contrast is structured as a work-and-ledger process linking deed, wage, debt, right, and settlement.

parent_channels.name: Moral Contact, Shielding, and Cover (P2: 53:19-32)

subchannels.scene_or_process: A person removes the body from dangerous contact, protects the exposed side, and stays behind a barrier before a major breach occurs.

subchannels.name: Forgiveness covers and restores exposed capacity

subchannels.name: Covenant and guarantee secure performance
subchannels.scene_or_process: The obligation is stabilized by covenant and by a guarantee that another future performance will occur.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant `quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`; guarantee `quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Binding speech matures from declaration into a secured obligation, pressing the audience to treat the warning as enforceable rather than rhetorical.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech binds future conduct when utterance is converted into vow, covenant, or secured guarantee.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The warning and disputed favors activate a legal-speech channel beneath the closing appeal.

parent_channels.name: S1. Gestation approaches visibility (P1: 53:1-18)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A concealed embryo nears delivery, becomes visibly discernible, and enters the nursing stage.
parent_channels.active_motifs: embryo `quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`; near delivery `quranic:root_000493:B004/m01`; visible pregnancy `quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`; seminal fluid `quranic:root_001492:B009/m01`; nursing ewe `quranic:root_000532:B009/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The movement from concealment to witnessed manifestation acquires a gestational analogue: nearness is the threshold at which hidden formation becomes visible and support-dependent.

parent_channels.name: S2. Failed milk supply interrupts nourishment (P1: 53:1-18)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Suckling is damaged, milk ceases or cannot be extracted, and the nursing relation fails.
parent_channels.active_motifs: suckling harmed by failed milk `quranic:root_001116:B003/m01`; milk ceasing `quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`; milk extraction `quranic:root_001416:B001/m01`; nursing ewe `quranic:root_000532:B009/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This compact latent scene pressures denial and dispute through failed nourishment: blockage at the source deprives a dependent receiver.

parent_channels.name: S3. Inner appraisal cannot certify itself (P2: 53:19-32)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The self forms an inward estimate of its own state, but that estimate remains subordinate to fuller knowledge and tested protection.
parent_channels.active_motifs: self or essence `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; inner intent `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; weak guess `quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`; insight through seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m02`; purification `quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`; piety `quranic:root_001677:B002/m02`; knowledge that uncovers `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Self-purification is epistemically unstable because the evaluator and evaluated object coincide; fuller knowledge must come from outside that loop.

parent_channels.name: S4. A penetrating torso wound disrupts breath (P2: 53:19-32)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A thrust opens a cavity in the side or lung, exposing the body's interior and impairing breath.
parent_channels.active_motifs: penetrating wound `quranic:root_000347:B009/m01`; gaping wound or empty cavity `quranic:root_001609:B007/m01`; breath `quranic:root_001533:B001/m01`; lung injury `quranic:root_000531:B009/m01`; disease or injury of the side `quranic:root_000262:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The channel gives “truth” a sharp, pressure-producing materialization: it penetrates the defended side and exposes an interior on which life depends.

parent_channels.name: S5. A palm raceme ripens into held provision (P3: 53:33-49)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Concealed growth rises through a tree, forms a palm raceme, and ripens into fruit that can be possessed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: palm raceme `quranic:root_001265:B004/m01`; ripening dates `quranic:root_001684:B016/m01`; rising growth `quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`; plant growth `quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`; acquired or stored provision `quranic:root_001265:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Enrichment is materialized as a maturation sequence in which hidden growth becomes a harvest capable of being retained.

parent_channels.name: S6. Sirius functions as a precise celestial marker (P3: 53:33-49)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A named bright star serves as a conspicuous marker whose recognition requires fine perception.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Sirius `quranic:root_000798:B008/m01`; conspicuous sign or marker `quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`; fine perception `quranic:root_000798:B005/m01`; landmark or road marker `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; lord or master `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Naming Sirius does not grant it agency; its precision as a marker instead sharpens the contrast between a legible sign and the lord who governs it.

parent_channels.name: S7. Blessings are turned into contention (P4: 53:50-62)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A beneficial grant becomes the object of doubt, sharp dispute, and wrangling rather than recognition.
parent_channels.active_motifs: blessings or benefits `quranic:root_000048:B004/m01`; sharp debate `quranic:root_001416:B003/m01`; doubt `quranic:root_001416:B004/m01`; wrangling `quranic:root_001609:B009/m01`; wonder `quranic:root_000984:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The question about favors is activated as a contested-benefit scene: what should elicit recognition is instead converted into argumentative resistance.

parent_channels.name: S8. Racehorses are aligned, released, and checked
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An unridden horse is led to a starting cord, aligned with the field, released by lengthening the rein, and tested for straightness, stride, hoof placement, and sound footing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: race-start cord `quranic:root_001269:B006/m01`; line-up point `quranic:root_001269:B006/m02`; leading an unridden horse `quranic:root_001519:B005/m01`; extending the rein to increase speed `quranic:root_000151:B007/m01`; broad rapid stride `quranic:root_001647:B006/m01`; matching hind and fore hoofprints `quranic:root_000347:B014/m01`; sideways running that resists straightening `quranic:root_001001:B012/m01`; protecting a painful hoof `quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes the surah's measured course as race discipline: alignment precedes speed, straight running is distinguishable from lateral deviation, and even strong forward motion remains accountable to precise footing.

parent_channels.name: S9. An intact-looking eye can misregister what it sees
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A visible pupil remains in place while a roving defect or woven film degrades perception from distortion, through double vision, to an eye whose globe remains intact after sight is gone.
parent_channels.active_motifs: reflected human image in the pupil `quranic:root_000059:B005/m01`; roving eye defect `quranic:root_000610:B007/m01`; woven film over the eye `quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`; seeing one object as two `quranic:root_000802:B006/m01`; intact visible eye globe `quranic:root_001273:B021/m01`; lost sight despite intact appearance `quranic:root_001273:B021/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This usefully pressures the witness language of 53:11-18: the mere presence of an eye or image does not guarantee a faithful report, so the insistence that sight neither drifted nor exceeded its bound becomes a concrete reliability condition.

parent_channels.name: S10. Marked gaming arrows allocate shares by chance
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A set of gaming arrows is kept in a leather holder, including a specifically ranked fifth arrow, and used in a procedure that divides portions and can assign a third share.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather holder for gaming arrows `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`; collected set of lots `quranic:root_000532:B010/m02`; fifth maysir arrow `quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`; division into shares `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; third portion `quranic:root_000203:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This reframes the disputed apportionment at 53:19-28 as a chance-allocation apparatus: a named lot can produce a share, but neither its label nor its desired outcome supplies the proof that the passage demands.

parent_channels.name: S11. A hunting party must verify the kill
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters set out, prepare a trapping pit, pursue quarry that runs and then stops to look behind, and finally inspect the struck animal to determine whether it has actually died.
parent_channels.active_motifs: setting out to hunt `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; hunter's trapping pit `quranic:root_001116:B004/m01`; quarry running a course `quranic:root_001290:B007/m01`; quarry stopping to look back `quranic:root_001290:B007/m02`; inspecting whether the quarry died `quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`; confirmed death `quranic:root_001454:B014/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes the surah's contrast between conjecture and warranted perception: movement, disappearance, or a successful strike is not enough, because the outcome still has to be observed and verified.

parent_channels.name: S12. Marriage joins pair, contract, and escorted transition
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two people stand in a marital pair, a marriage contract establishes the relation, and the bride is escorted to her spouse as the contract takes social effect.
parent_channels.active_motifs: marital spouse relation `quranic:root_000652:B002/m01`; marriage contract `quranic:root_001444:B004/m01`; bride as participant `quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`; escorting the bride to her spouse `quranic:root_001583:B006/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This supports the creation of pairs at 53:45 by materializing pairing as an enacted relation, while usefully pressuring the mere assignment of gendered names at 53:27: a label alone does not perform the relation that contract and transition establish.

parent_channels.name: S13. A slave earns the price of release
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person held in slavery performs remunerated work toward the price of the neck, settles the remaining due, gains release, and enters the legal patronage created by manumission.
parent_channels.active_motifs: enslavement `quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`; labor toward one's own price `quranic:root_000709:B005/m01`; unpaid balance of the redemption price `quranic:root_000709:B005/m02`; release when the price is met `quranic:root_000709:B005/m03`; debt settlement `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; patronage after manumission `quranic:root_001684:B005/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes 53:39-41 as a status-changing settlement: the person's own striving generates the payment, and full discharge of the due produces release rather than a transferable reward.

parent_channels.name: S14. The dead are shrouded, carried, and hidden in a grave
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The dead body is covered in a shroud, raised on a bier, carried to a grave, and placed below sight.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bier or funeral carrier `quranic:root_000067:B008/m03`; object carried aloft `quranic:root_001042:B008/m01`; covering the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; shroud `quranic:root_000266:B009/m02`; grave `quranic:root_000266:B009/m03`; burial below sight `quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes the interval between causing death at 53:44 and producing the later arising at 53:47: burial is a deliberate concealment of the body, so renewed emergence answers a concrete passage below sight rather than an abstract cessation.

parent_channels.name: S15. A drink is reduced, rested, and taken by measured sips
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Fire heats a covered cooking place until two-thirds of a drink are gone; the remaining third is transferred to a large vessel, rested until it improves, and consumed in paced sips.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking fire and heat `quranic:root_001122:B001/m01`; oven cover `quranic:root_001669:B005/m01`; drink reduced until one third remains `quranic:root_000203:B008/m01`; storage vessel `quranic:root_000067:B010/m01`; resting the drink for days `quranic:root_000067:B010/m02`; improved drink after resting `quranic:root_000067:B010/m03`; large jar `quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`; sip `quranic:root_001533:B006/m01`; pause between sips `quranic:root_001533:B006/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This usefully pressures the surah's disputed “third” by making a third an exact remainder produced through observable loss and controlled handling, unlike the self-serving share assignment at 53:21-22.

parent_channels.name: S16. A well-made cloth can lie by its appearance
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Cloth is tightly woven, given its first fold, dyed or ornamented so that its appearance misstates its condition, and displayed for inspection or sale.
parent_channels.active_motifs: tightly woven cloth `quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`; first fold of a cloth `quranic:root_001226:B007/m01`; dyed or ornamented cloth `quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`; cloth that lies by its condition `quranic:root_001290:B009/m02`; merchandise displayed for inspection `quranic:root_001001:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This usefully pressures the claim that the heart did not belie what it saw: a polished surface can itself “lie,” so reliable witnessing requires correspondence between appearance and underlying condition, not visual attractiveness alone.

parent_channels.name: S17. Supplication joins invocation, “amen,” and tears
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshiper invokes the divine name, asks for response by saying “amen,” and gives the plea bodily force through tears and a voiced cry.
parent_channels.active_motifs: divine name in invocation `quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`; saying “amen” `quranic:root_000054:B003/m01`; request for response `quranic:root_000054:B003/m02`; tears `quranic:root_000147:B001/m02`; voiced weeping `quranic:root_000147:B001/m03`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This supports the closing call to worship and the rebuke for laughing rather than weeping by reframing tears as directed supplication: affect becomes speech seeking an answer rather than an undirected display.

parent_channels.name: S18. A vow is discharged through sanctuary offering and worship
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person assumes a vow, dedicates and sends an offering to the sanctuary, and completes the act at a prayer place through worship.
parent_channels.active_motifs: self-imposed vow `quranic:root_001488:B002/m01`; sanctuary offering `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`; sending the offering `quranic:root_001583:B005/m02`; prayer place `quranic:root_000675:B002/m01`; worship `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes the final command to worship as an enacted obligation involving declared commitment, dedicated property, movement toward a sacred destination, and bodily completion.

parent_channels.name: S19. Armed opponents descend into a duel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Opponents prepare shield and war gear, descend together to the fighting ground, stand against one another, and exchange a sword blow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mutual descent for a duel `quranic:root_001492:B007/m01`; standing against an opponent `quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`; war gear `quranic:root_001643:B003/m01`; shield `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; warrior not frightened by battle `quranic:root_001390:B004/m01`; sword blow `quranic:root_001088:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This reframes the surah's closing posture as a role reversal: the body that stands against an opponent in resistant parity is finally commanded to lower itself in worship, while the destroyed peoples show the terminal cost of sustained opposition.

parent_channels.name: S20. Perfume is prepared and applied as gendered presentation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic wood is heated, a gender-coded perfume mixture is prepared, and the scent is applied to produce an outward social presentation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: incense wood `quranic:root_001058:B010/m02`; heating perfume `quranic:root_000973:B012/m01`; perfume associated with women `quranic:root_000058:B007/m01`; perfume mixture `quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`; applying perfume `quranic:root_000434:B010/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This usefully pressures the female naming at 53:27 by distinguishing a gender-coded presentation that is materially prepared and applied from evidence about what an unseen being is.

parent_channels.name: S21. Daylight opens, reaches its meridian, and declines (P1, P2, P4; causal-sequence bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dawn opens, daylight rises into its prime, the sun reaches the standing point of noon, and then inclines into decline.
parent_channels.active_motifs: opening of dawn `quranic:root_001533:B009/m01`; rising daylight `quranic:root_000782:B005/m01`; prime of day `quranic:root_001281:B013/m01`; standing noon or meridian `quranic:root_001273:B017/m01`; solar inclination and decline `quranic:root_000658:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P2-P4 bridge is the causal sequence dawn opening -> rising day -> meridian -> decline. It reframes the surah's celestial witnessing and approaching event as temporally calibrated movement: position and change, rather than impression, disclose where the observer stands in the cycle.

parent_channels.name: S22. A shared property is valued, preempted, and transferred (P1-P3; causal-sequence and legal-role bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A resident remains in a shared house while the co-owners value and bid for one another's shares, a neighboring owner invokes preemption, and the property is transferred at a known price.
parent_channels.active_motifs: resident fixed in a house `quranic:root_001267:B005/m01`; co-owner bidding until one buys the other shares `quranic:root_001274:B004/m01`; neighbor's priority to annex a sold share `quranic:root_000802:B003/m01`; resale or transfer at a known price `quranic:root_001684:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P3 bridge is a legal-role progression from resident and co-owners, through valuation and preemption, to purchaser and transfer. It usefully pressures the arbitrary apportionment in 53:19-28: a share becomes enforceable through identified ownership, valuation, priority, and a known price, not through naming or desire.

parent_channels.name: S23. A poem is metered, circulated, and found corruptible (P1-P4; repeated-scene-signature and contrast bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A poet composes metrical verse and sends praise or satire to another person, while the meter or the truth of the performance can fail.
parent_channels.active_motifs: metrical poetry and the poet's craft `quranic:root_000798:B007/m01`; prosodic meter `quranic:root_001001:B014/m01`; metrical or rhyme defect `quranic:root_001274:B002/m01`; presenting praise or satire in verse `quranic:root_001583:B011/m01`; fabrication turned away from truth `quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P4 bridge is a repeated scene signature of composition, formal checking, social circulation, and possible fabrication. The contrast usefully pressures 53:3-4: meter and circulation can coexist with formal or semantic corruption, so they cannot supply the warrant that revelation receives from its source and faithful transmission.

parent_channels.name: S24. A head wound deteriorates and incurs assessed compensation (P2-P4; causal-sequence and role-progression bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A penetrating head wound reaches the brain, gathers pus, swells or relapses after improvement, and becomes an injury for which compensation is legally assessed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cranial wound reaching the brain `quranic:root_000053:B003/m01`; penetrating wound reaching a body cavity or the brain `quranic:root_001518:B005/m01`; pus gathered in a wound or abscess `quranic:root_000281:B006/m01`; swelling in a wound `quranic:root_000739:B007/m01`; relapse of a wound after improvement `quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`; obligatory compensation for a wound `quranic:root_001488:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P2-P4 bridge is the causal and legal progression injury -> complication -> assessed due. It materializes the surah's insistence that action reaches full recompense: bodily harm creates a concrete liability rather than a burden that another person can casually absorb.

parent_channels.name: S25. Known weights verify an exactly balanced coin (P2-P4; exact-measure bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A working weight standard and a known unit are applied to a dinar, which passes only when it equals one mithqal without tipping the balance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mana as a working weight standard `quranic:root_001450:B006/m01`; uqiyya as a known unit `quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`; dinar weighing exactly one mithqal `quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`; no overbalance `quranic:root_001273:B015/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P2-P4 bridge is the invariant benchmark -> known unit -> balance check. It materializes the full recompense of 53:39-41 as an auditable measure whose exactness is established against standards rather than estimated from wish or self-assessment.

parent_channels.name: S26. A beautiful green tree bears bitter tanning fruit (P1, P4; object-property bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An alaa tree presents attractive green foliage while its taste is bitter and its fruiting load supplies material for tanning.
parent_channels.active_motifs: beautiful tree `quranic:root_000048:B005/m01`; bitter taste `quranic:root_000048:B005/m02`; green leaved alaa tree `quranic:root_000076:B005/m01`; fruiting load used for tanning `quranic:root_000076:B005/m02`; bitterness in a plant `quranic:root_001414:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 53:6 (م ر ر); 53:55 (ء ل و); ء ل ي is unavailable in `surface_context.root_occurrences` (bundle ayahs 53:10, 53:42, 53:55).
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P4 bridge is one object's stable property sequence: attractive appearance, bitter taste, and practical use. It usefully pressures the question about favors at 53:55 because benefit need not coincide with immediate sweetness; a bitter fruit can still materialize a productive grant.

parent_channels.name: S27. A cloth test distinguishes menstruation from purity (P1-P3; diagnostic-evidence bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A private menstrual state leaves yellow or white residue on a cloth, which is inspected to distinguish menstruation from purity while the bodily site remains concealed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: concealed pudendum or womb `quranic:root_000383:B011/m01`; yellow or white discharge `quranic:root_000531:B007/m01`; cloth test for menstruation versus purity `quranic:root_000531:B007/m02`; preserving modesty through covering `quranic:root_001265:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P3 bridge is a diagnostic invariant in which a hidden state becomes classifiable through an external trace. It materializes the warning not to declare oneself pure at 53:32: purity is distinguished by discriminating evidence rather than secured by self-assertion.

parent_channels.name: S28. A chick breaks from the egg and leaves the shell empty (P1: 53:1-18)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The egg splits, the chick exits in an irreversible separation, and the former enclosure remains empty.
parent_channels.active_motifs: splitting egg shell `quranic:root_001267:B003/m01`; irreversible separation after exit `quranic:root_001267:B003/m02`; chick outside the egg `quranic:root_001274:B006/m01`; emptied shell `quranic:root_001274:B006/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Hatching gives the later arising of 53:47 a compact material analogue: living form ruptures a sealed enclosure and leaves its prior container empty, so emergence is a change of state rather than continued concealment.

parent_channels.name: S29. An enslaved woman is forced to earn an imposed sexual quota (P2-P3; causal and responsibility bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An owner imposes a revenue quota on an enslaved young woman and requires her to meet it through prostitution.
parent_channels.active_motifs: enslaved young woman `quranic:root_000053:B014/m01`; owner-imposed quota `quranic:root_000709:B007/m01`; coerced sexual earnings `quranic:root_000709:B007/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P2-P3 bridge is the causal sequence status constraint -> imposed quota -> extracted earnings. This usefully pressures 53:38-41 by distinguishing a victim's coerced proceeds from freely directed striving and by keeping responsibility with the agent who imposes the extraction.

parent_channels.name: S30. A harmful gaze marks the viewed body with affliction (P2: 53:19-32)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: In a source-attested harmful-eye scene, a gazer fixes on a target, the eye is understood to strike with harm, and bodily affliction appears.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gaze cast to afflict a viewed target `quranic:root_001533:B003/m01`; harmful eye striking with evil `quranic:root_001378:B007/m01`; bodily affliction or skin disease `quranic:root_000755:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This usefully pressures the visual witness of 53:11-18 by contrasting receptive, bounded seeing with a gaze construed as acting upon and injuring its object. Reliable witnessing is thereby distinguished from projection onto what is viewed.

parent_channels.name: S31. An attendant apparition culminates in a temporary swoon (P1-P4; causal-sequence and contrast bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An attendant jinni follows and appears to a person, touch covers reason, consciousness collapses into a seizure or swoon, and the person later recovers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: attendant jinni `quranic:root_000175:B010/m01`; appearing jinni `quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`; jinn touch and incipient madness `quranic:root_001378:B004/m01`; reason covered by madness `quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`; understanding covered in a swoon `quranic:root_001088:B005/m01`; temporary seizure or swoon followed by recovery `quranic:root_001454:B009/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P4 bridge is a causal sequence apparition -> touch -> covered understanding -> collapse -> recovery, set in contrast with the opening's stable witness. It sharpens the primary reading by distinguishing bounded, coherent disclosure from a transient episode defined by impaired awareness.

parent_channels.name: S32. A son becomes his father's companion and later recalls youth (P1, P4; role-progression bridge)
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A son reaches full bodily and mental maturity, becomes capable of companionship with his father, and in old age identifies himself by looking back on his youth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: son maturing into his father's companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; completed bodily and mental youth `quranic:root_000766:B005/m01`; mature strength, judgment, and experience `quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`; elder defined by recalling former youth `quranic:root_001332:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P4 bridge is the role progression dependent son -> mature companion -> retrospective elder. It reframes “your companion” at 53:2 as an accountable human relation grounded in matured reason and materializes the lifetime across which striving becomes retrospectively legible.
